title: 軌道幾何動態檢測~Dynamic track-geometry inspection
focus: 動態幾何量測取樣基準與事件定位~Dynamic geometry sampling datums and event location
summary: 軌道幾何動態檢測以「動態幾何量測取樣基準與事件定位」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。動態軌道幾何檢測把車載慣性與相對位移轉為沿線幾何，速度、濾波及定位誤差會影響結果，單次超標需能回到明確里程與原始訊號。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops dynamic geometry sampling datums and event location through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Dynamic geometry inspection converts onboard inertia and relative displacement into track geometry; speed, filtering and localization affect results, and an exceedance must be traceable to chainage and raw signals. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把軌道幾何動態檢測放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。動態軌道幾何檢測把車載慣性與相對位移轉為沿線幾何，速度、濾波及定位誤差會影響結果，單次超標需能回到明確里程與原始訊號。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Dynamic track-geometry inspection in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Dynamic geometry inspection converts onboard inertia and relative displacement into track geometry; speed, filtering and localization affect results, and an exceedance must be traceable to chainage and raw signals. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz；y=v/fs=0.05 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.055 m。模型邊界：車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=0.05 m；y=2*dx=0.1 m。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=0.11 m。模型邊界：均勻取樣且帶限訊號；兩倍點距是理論界限而非準確重建保證；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz; y=v/fs=0.05 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.055 m. Boundary: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=0.05 m; y=2*dx=0.1 m. Increasing only dx with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.11 m. Boundary: Uniform sampling and a band-limited signal; twice the spacing is a theoretical boundary, not guaranteed accurate reconstruction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 取樣空間解析度~Sampling spatial resolution
units.title: 取樣空間解析度~Sampling spatial resolution
units.mechanism: 同一時間取樣率在不同速度對應不同沿程解析度。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.055 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力。使用車速與逐筆時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A fixed temporal sampling rate gives different spatial resolution at different speeds. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.055 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power. Use speed and per-sample timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.055 m. Boundary: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以車速與逐筆時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用每筆共同時鐘時間、速度及里程位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「取樣空間解析度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use speed and per-sample timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using common-clock timestamps, speed and chainage for every sample, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sampling spatial resolution. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣。這個失效與「取樣空間解析度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查車速與逐筆時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling. This failure and a measurement bias in Sampling spatial resolution can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed and per-sample timestamps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling.
units.practice: 重算「取樣空間解析度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣造成偏離的合成觀察，以車速與逐筆時間戳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Sampling spatial resolution, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling. Explain which evidence in speed and per-sample timestamps distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 最低無混疊波長~Minimum unaliased wavelength
units.title: 最低無混疊波長~Minimum unaliased wavelength
units.mechanism: 奈奎斯特界限是必要條件，實際保真通常需更多點。本模型把 dx 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.11 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻取樣且帶限訊號；兩倍點距是理論界限而非準確重建保證。使用原始與抗混疊濾波訊號作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未濾高頻會讓短波折返成長波，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~The Nyquist limit is necessary, while practical fidelity usually needs more samples. In this model, dx is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.11 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform sampling and a band-limited signal; twice the spacing is a theoretical boundary, not guaranteed accurate reconstruction. Use raw and anti-aliased signals as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unfiltered high frequencies fold short waves into longer waves; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 時間延遲定位差~Latency position error
units.title: 時間延遲定位差~Latency position error
units.mechanism: 感測與定位不同步會把缺陷移到錯誤里程。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。延遲期間速度恆定且延遲已知；不含定位本身的偏差。使用感測器共同時鐘作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；固定延遲在高速形成更大定位誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Unsynchronized sensing and localization move a defect to the wrong chainage. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.1 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed is constant during known latency; localization bias itself is excluded. Use a shared sensor clock as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Fixed latency creates larger position error at higher speed; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 m/s, tau=0.02 s；y=v*tau=1 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.1 m。模型邊界：延遲期間速度恆定且延遲已知；不含定位本身的偏差；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 m/s, tau=0.02 s; y=v*tau=1 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 m. Boundary: Speed is constant during known latency; localization bias itself is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.anchor: 慣性偏差位移漂移~Inertial-bias displacement drift
units.title: 慣性偏差位移漂移~Inertial-bias displacement drift
units.mechanism: 固定加速度偏差經雙積分形成二次位移漂移。本模型把 bias 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.055 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定加速度零偏且初始速度位置誤差為零。使用靜止零偏與外部位置基準作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；長時間積分會把微小偏差放大，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Constant acceleration bias produces quadratic displacement drift after double integration. In this model, bias is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.055 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Constant acceleration bias with zero initial velocity and position errors. Use stationary bias and external position reference as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Long integration amplifies a small bias; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.verify: 本單元以交叉相關與固定地標區分模型與觀察，先用固定地標定位、交叉相關位移及配準後殘差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「重複通過差值」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use cross-correlation and fixed landmarks to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using fixed-landmark registration, correlation displacement and registered residuals, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Repeat-pass difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化。這個失效與「重複通過差值」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查交叉相關與固定地標，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different. This failure and a measurement bias in Repeat-pass difference can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check cross-correlation and fixed landmarks rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「重複通過差值」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩次資料已配準至同里程與相同方向；量測條件可比較如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化造成偏離的合成觀察，以交叉相關與固定地標說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Repeat-pass difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different. Explain which evidence in cross-correlation and fixed landmarks distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 檢測率統計~Detection recall
units.mechanism: 檢出率須使用含漏檢的已知真值集。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 90.4762 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。真值集完整且事件配對規則固定；結果是樣本召回率。使用盲測標註與事件配對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Recall requires a known truth set including missed defects. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 90.4762 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. The truth set is complete and event-matching rule fixed; the result is sample recall. Use blinded truth labels and event matching as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Counting only reported events hides misses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=18 count, FN=2 count；y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent。只把 TP 增加一個整數單位，y=90.4762 percent。模型邊界：真值集完整且事件配對規則固定；結果是樣本召回率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=18 count, FN=2 count; y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent. Increasing only TP with an increase of one whole unit gives y=90.4762 percent. Boundary: The truth set is complete and event-matching rule fixed; the result is sample recall; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以盲測標註與事件配對區分模型與觀察，先用盲測真值表、逐事件判定及漏檢清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢測率統計」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use blinded truth labels and event matching to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using blinded truth table, event-by-event decisions and missed-event list, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Detection recall. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。這個失效與「檢測率統計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測標註與事件配對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Counting only reported events hides misses. This failure and a measurement bias in Detection recall can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded truth labels and event matching rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
